'''The Lost and Forgotten''' are a pair of normal {{2|Monsters|Enemies}} found in {{2|Glory}}. They always appear together.

== The Lost ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = The Lost
|Image  = StS2_The Lost.png
|HP     = 93
|AscHP  = 99
|Powers = {{BD2|Possess Strength}}
|Debut  = Glory
|Type   = Normal
}} 
{{Power Infobox
|Name         = Possess Strength
|Image        = StS2 Icon PossessStrength.png
|Description  = When killed, return all stolen {{BD2|Strength}} to the player.
|Type         = Buff
|Stacks       = Does not stack
|BetweenTurns = Permanent
|Cap          = 
|GivesToPlayer = Strength
}}

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|The Lost}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Debilitating Smog
|Intent = Debuff, Buff
|Effect = Removes 2 {{BD2|Strength}} from the player and gains 2 {{BD2|Strength}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Strength
|GivesToPlayer = Strength (Negative)
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Eye Lasers
|Intent = Attack2
|Effect = Deals (4;{{Asc2|9|5}}) damage x2.
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Alternates between {{Int2|The Lost|Debilitating Smog}} and {{Int2|The Lost|Eye Lasers}}, starting with {{Int2|The Lost|Debilitating Smog}}.

{{Clear}}

== The Forgotten ==
{{Enemy Infobox
|Name   = The Forgotten
|Image  = StS2_The Forgotten.png
|HP     = 106
|AscHP  = 111
|Powers = {{BD2|Possess Speed}}
|Debut  = Glory
|Type   = Normal
}} 
{{Power Infobox
|Name         = Possess Speed
|Image        = StS2 Icon PossessSpeed.png
|Description  = When killed, return all stolen {{BD2|Dexterity}} to the player.
|Type         = Buff
|Stacks       = Does not stack
|BetweenTurns = Permanent
|Cap          = 
|GivesToPlayer = Dexterity
}}

=== Pattern ===
{{Intents Table/start|The Forgotten}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Miasma
|Intent = Debuff, Defend, Buff
|Effect = Removes 2 {{BD2|Dexterity}} from the player. Gains 8 {{KW2|Block}} and 2 {{BD2|Dexterity}}.
|GivesToEnemy = Dexterity, Block
|GivesToPlayer = Dexterity (Negative)
}}
{{Intents Table/row
|Name   = Dread
|Intent = Attack3
|Effect = Deals (13;{{Asc2|9|15}}) damage plus the amount of {{BD2|Dexterity}} the Forgotten has.
|InteractsWith = Dexterity
}}
{{Intents Table/end}}
Alternates between {{Int2|The Forgotten|Miasma}} and {{Int2|The Forgotten|Dread}}, starting with {{Int2|The Forgotten|Miasma}}.

{{Clear}}

== Trivia ==
* {{M2|The Forgotten}} is the only enemy in the game that can gain {{BD2|Dexterity}}.
